lines: A resort beach recreated inside the holographic facility at the back of the high-end club.
This facility was built with meticulous attention to detail; even the sunlight hitting the shoreline contains the same ultraviolet rays as reality.
In other words, sun protection was a must──.
Me
Then, Saeko-san, I'm going to start applying it now...?
Saeko
Ah. I leave it to you. You're going to a lot of trouble, Fuuma-kun.
Saying that, Saeko-san turned her gaze slightly toward me and smiled.
She was currently lying face down on a sheet spread out on the sandy beach.
From my angle, I couldn't see the important parts, but she had taken off the top of her bikini as well.
Me
(Kuuu, t-this is dangerous! I never expected things to turn out like this...!)
While maintaining the appearance of a calm gentleman on the surface, I was internally in a state of intense excitement.
After all, I was being allowed to apply sun oil to the back of the super-beautiful Saeko-san.
This could truly be called the dream of every man in the world.
When I was explaining the sunlight on the holographic beach, I had a faint sense of anticipation, but
I never imagined the situation would actually develop this way.
Me
(Still, stay calm...! This is for sunscreen, and there is absolutely no strange meaning behind it!)
Saeko
Fufu. What is it, Fuuma-kun? Stop muttering to yourself and hurry up and apply it.
Saeko
I have my top off too, so I'm feeling a bit embarrassed like this.
Me
Ah. I'm sorry! As you command!
My attempt at being a gentleman was ruined.
I hurriedly rubbed the oil into both my hands and touched Saeko-san's back.
Saeko
...! Fufu, this is... how should I put it, it's a little ticklish, nnn...
Me
I-is that so!? But please bear with me for just a moment, it will be over soon...!
Saeko
Haha, there's no need to rush. Your reactions are truly entertaining every single time.
Me
Ah, thank you...
Saeko-san was smiling happily while I applied the oil to her.
It was the composed expression of a mature woman who had seen right through all of my excitement and agitation.
Saeko
Fuuma-kun, you don't have much experience with this kind of thing, do you? Like applying oil to a woman's skin?
Me
I suppose so... It's not like I've never done it, but I'll leave that part unspoken.
Saeko
Fufu, I see. But to be honest, I'm in a similar boat.
Saeko
...Or rather, I never thought I'd get to spend another moment like this, with such ordinary, student-like peace.
Me
Saeko-san...?
Saeko's voice took on a slightly darker tone.
Saeko
No, as you know, the world I lived in has collapsed. It was destroyed by 'them'—the hordes of the dead.
Saeko
Not just the cities, but the seas and mountains too... 'They' appear everywhere, seeking their prey.
Saeko
Relaxing on a beach like this is probably just a dream now.
Me
I see, I thought.
In Saeko's world, even the coastlines were occupied by hordes of the dead.
That was why today, she had made the request to "see a peaceful sea."
Me
It must have been a desperate situation... Truly, just surviving was all you could manage.
I said this to Saeko.
I had experienced the terror of the dead hordes firsthand during this incident.
In our world, their activity was limited to one city, so it ended with that much damage,
but otherwise, it would have led to a far more catastrophic outcome.
Saeko
Yes... But to be honest, I didn't despair.
Saeko
I adapted to the appearance of 'them' more than I expected myself to.
Saeko
...If anything, I was disappointed in myself for that.
Saeko laughed with a hint of self-deprecation.
Me
...? Why do you say that...?
Saeko
It's because... even before 'they' appeared, I harbored a certain desire.
Saeko
Ethics and society didn't matter. I wanted to wield the power I had gained through training exactly as I pleased... a dark desire like that.
Saeko
So when 'they' appeared, I didn't despair. Instead, I felt a surge of exhilaration...
Me
It was the joy of having gained an "enemy."
I swung my sword to my heart's content, slaughtering the zombies and pressing on through the deadly terrain.
She secretly felt ashamed of herself for feeling so exhilarated in such a situation.
Saeko
...But "he" was the one who accepted all of my wretchedness.
Saeko smiled as she said that.
"He" must refer to a certain man she had fought alongside in that other world.
Saeko
"He" acknowledged my base desires and told me, "That's fine."
Saeko
So... yes. To me, "he" is the most precious existence.
Saeko
No matter how safe this world is, it means nothing without "him."
Saeko
Fufu. Well, I suppose I've already told you this much yesterday.
Me
Haha. That's right.
Yesterday, after defeating the demon guarding the gate to the other world, I had suggested to Saeko and the others that they stay in this world.
This world isn't completely peaceful either, but it should be safer than that place where hordes of the dead roam.
But they shook their heads.
Their "reason to live" did not exist in this world.
What matters is not which world you live in, but how you choose to live, they said.
Saeko
Fuuma-kun, from what I've seen... I think you have the potential to become someone's "reason to live" as well.
Saeko
Just as "he" is to me. So──
Saeko
For the sake of the women who look up to you, please become a good man.
Me
D-Do I really have girls like that...? I'll do my best, Saeko-san.
I nodded firmly at Saeko's heartfelt words.
